notes:
- Feature: customers buy license keys themselves in the store at https://qx-license.powerledger-data.workers.dev/ : an account (email + password), a plan (7 days, 30 days, lifetime), payment in crypto straight to the seller's own wallets (USDT and USDC on 10 networks, plus BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, TON, TRX, LTC, DOGE, POL, AVAX; no payment company, no fees), and the key appears automatically when the payment is confirmed. The admin portal moved to /admin and gained Orders, Customers and Payment networks.
- The extension's license screen links to the store ("No key yet? Buy one in the store"), and Settings has a "Buy or renew" link.
- Payment safety: only a transfer with the order's exact unique amount pays automatically; a pasted transaction ID with any other amount, a late payment in a coin whose price moves, or a payment to a cancelled order goes to the admin's Review list. Every on-chain transfer pays one order at most, and an order gets one key at most.
